compatibility_scope.predicate: Actual Canonical P equals latest pre-enqueue Owner-available Private P at same Session/audio frontier
compatibility_scope.denominator: Only pre-enqueue Private nodes accepted by owner into proposal-results (display event, not obsolete). No-node is excluded, never failure.
compatibility_scope.probability: Beta(0.5,0.5) posterior mean (matches+.5)/(support+1), only support>=8; otherwise null
compatibility_scope.interval: Wilson z=1.959963984540054 on raw transition counts; descriptive repeated-observation interval, not IID/clustered inferential guarantee

source.source_pool: All prior V5 pilot sources are training/diagnostic for this extension, not held-out
